ops.text: Cross-repo plugin floors go stale before their PR lands: a long-running PR that needs an unreleased cc-slack change must guess cc-slack's next patch release in plugin.json, but cc-slack tags a release on every merge to main (0.20.47 to 0.20.54 on Nov 15 alone). j4040's yasyf/cc-skills#5444 had its floor overtaken three times (0.20.48, 0.20.51, 0.20.53) while yasyf/cc-slack#440 waited, each bump a rebase and a full CI rerun, and yasyf/cc-skills#5372 calls its floor a guess too. Fix: let the lander write the floor when it merges the dependent PR, from the release tag the dependency's merge produced (it already merges the cc-slack PR first and knows its merge sha), so the PR carries a marker such as cc-slack@<PR url> instead of a version.
